claims: Easter Island (Rapa Nui) is a special territory of Chile.
Easter Island (Rapa Nui) is in the southeastern Pacific.
Easter Island (Rapa Nui) has nearly 1,000 monumental moai statues.
Easter Island's moai statues were created by early Polynesian settlers.
Easter Island (Rapa Nui) is a UNESCO World Heritage site.
Easter Island (Rapa Nui) has about 5,000 residents.
Easter Island's moai statues represent deified ancestors.
Easter Island's moai statues were carved by the Rapa Nui people.
Many statues still remain at the Rano Raraku quarry.
Easter Island was settled by Polynesians possibly around 700-1200 CE.
Easter Island is known for Rongo Rongo, a unique writing system.
Easter Island has the Birdman cult (Tangata manu) at Orongo.
Easter Island is located over 2,000 miles off the coast of Chile.
Easter Island is a volcanic island.
Easter Island has three dormant volcanoes.
The only way to visit Easter Island is by flying from Santiago, Chile.
The flight from Santiago, Chile to Easter Island takes roughly 4.5 hours.
A 2025 study warns that rising sea levels may impact coastal, culturally significant sites.
